typography.source_body: Song/SimSun 10.56 pt Tr0; source Latin counterpart Times New Roman
typography.source_heading: Hei 15.96 pt; date12 pt; original Latin counterpart Calibri
typography.korean: Official Noto Serif CJK KR Regular400 for Song, Noto Sans CJK KR Regular400 for Hei. Actual source font size and baseline retained.
typography.english: Body: installed original SimSun. Source SimHei title/date has no complete embedded or installed same-face font; Calibri400 is the original actual same-run Latin counterpart.
typography.placement: Prose slots between native math glyphs, at original baselines. Same-line ordinary score/figure-reference/Carnot-process/X-ray language groups are explicitly listed. ASCII inter-word gaps are recorded; one English prose start has a documented +0.65pt horizontal offset within its existing slot to keep antialiasing clear of native t. No scientific glyph is moved.
typography.raster_limits: The original raster labels have no recoverable font/size/baseline metadata. Serif structure and same-document Song outline measurements infer nominal 10.15pt FEL,11.60pt diffraction and10.67pt crystal labels. Those inferences, rotations and language-only erasure boxes are recorded in raster-labels.json.
